approved_payload.content: A police sergeant stationed at Mthatha Central police station was shot dead during an early-morning police operation at Lwandlana village outside Mthatha on Tuesday 17 November. According to the Hawks, as relayed by the office of Transport and Community Safety MEC Xolile Nqatha, officers had gone to a home to arrest a person of interest and an occupant opened fire when they knocked. The reports differ on his age (43 or 45) and on whether he died at the scene or in hospital. The suspect was still being sought. The map point is approximate: the Mthatha town point, not the village.

Neither is in Nominatim near Mthatha (its only "Tabase" is a village in Elundini), so the pin is the Mthatha city point (-31.5896, 28.7878). Area level, about 10 km.
